### Relative error and informativeness of the intervals {#sec-relerr}

MSE ratios compare the two fits but not the size of the error relative to the effect. Per
replicate and estimand (`analysis/relative-error.R` → `summaries/final/relative-error.csv`):

- relative error √(grid mean of (estimate − truth)² / grid mean of truth²); for the mean and α(t)
  the denominator uses the truth centred at its grid mean (their level is not the effect), while the
  numerator keeps any level error; 1 means the error is as large as the effect;
- relative half-width, the interval's root-mean-square half-width on the same scale;
- detection: the share of grid points with |truth| > 25% of max |truth| where the interval excludes
  zero on the side of the truth (β, γ, f);
- wrong sign: the share of all grid points where the interval excludes zero on the wrong side.

Cell values are medians over replicates (relative error, half-width) or means (detection, wrong
sign, coverage).

```{r relerr-load}
REL <- read_summary("final", "relative-error") |>
  left_join(S |> distinct(cell, block, family, signal, error, G, truth, basis, extra), by = "cell") |>
  mutate(dependence = if_else(error == "iid", "independent", "dependent"))
LSP <- read_summary("final", "log-sp-spread") |>
  left_join(S |> distinct(cell, block, family, signal, error, G, truth, basis), by = "cell")
REL_ARMS <- c(reml_model = "REML, model-based", reml_cl2 = "REML + CL2", ncv_cl2 = "NCV + CL2",
              ncv_cl2_bias = "NCV + CL2, bias-aware", ar1_model = "AR(1) working model")
rel_sum <- REL |>
  filter(estimand %in% c("beta", "mean", "gamma", "alpha")) |>
  group_by(estimand, dependence, arm) |>
  summarise(
    cells = n(),
    coverage = median(coverage),
    rel_error_max = max(rel_rmse_median),
    cells_rel_gt_0.5 = sum(rel_rmse_median > 0.5),
    rel_error = median(rel_rmse_median),
    reps_rel_gt_1 = mean(share_rel_gt_1),
    halfwidth = median(rel_halfwidth_median),
    detect_min = min(detect),
    wrong_sign_max = max(wrong_sign),
    detect = median(detect),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(arm = factor(REL_ARMS[arm], REL_ARMS), estimand = label_estimand(estimand)) |>
  select(estimand, dependence, arm, cells, coverage, rel_error, rel_error_max, cells_rel_gt_0.5, reps_rel_gt_1, halfwidth, detect, detect_min, wrong_sign_max) |>
  arrange(estimand, dependence, arm)
save_tab(rel_sum, "relative-error-summary")
rs <- \(e, dep, a, col) rel_sum[[col]][rel_sum$estimand == label_estimand(e) & rel_sum$dependence == dep & rel_sum$arm == REL_ARMS[[a]]]
rel_core <- REL |>
  filter(block == "core", estimand == "beta", arm %in% c("reml_cl2", "ncv_cl2")) |>
  mutate(fit = if_else(arm == "reml_cl2", "REML", "NCV")) |>
  select(family, signal, error, G, fit, rel_rmse_median) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = fit, values_from = rel_rmse_median) |>
  mutate(ratio = REML / NCV) |>
  arrange(family, error, G, signal)
save_tab(rel_core, "relative-error-core-beta")
rr <- \(dep) rel_core$ratio[if (dep == "iid") rel_core$error == "iid" else rel_core$error != "iid"]
lsp_core <- LSP |>
  filter(block == "core", signal == "mid", fit %in% c("REML", "NCV"), grepl("^te\\(", term)) |>
  group_by(family, error, G, fit) |>
  summarise(log_sp_sd = mean(log_sp_sd), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = fit, values_from = log_sp_sd) |>
  arrange(family, error, G)
save_tab(lsp_core, "log-sp-spread-core")
ls <- \(f, dep) lsp_core[[f]][if (dep == "iid") lsp_core$error == "iid" else lsp_core$error != "iid"]
```

```{r fig-relerr}
#| fig-cap: "Relative error of the REML and NCV estimates of β(s,t) per synthetic cell (median over replicates; log scales), by dependence; colour = family, dashed: equal error, dotted: error as large as the effect."
#| fig-height: 3.6
d <- REL |>
  filter(estimand == "beta", arm %in% c("reml_cl2", "ncv_cl2")) |>
  mutate(fit = if_else(arm == "reml_cl2", "REML", "NCV")) |>
  select(cell, family, dependence, fit, rel_rmse_median) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = fit, values_from = rel_rmse_median) |>
  mutate(family = label_family(family))
fig <- ggplot(d, aes(NCV, REML, colour = family)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 3, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 3, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~dependence) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "NCV: relative error of beta", y = "REML: relative error of beta", colour = NULL) +
  theme_doc
save_fig(fig, "relative-error-beta", 6.5, 3.6)
fig
```

Under independent errors both fits estimate β well: median relative error
`r f(rs("beta", "independent", "reml_cl2", "rel_error"), 2)` (REML) and
`r f(rs("beta", "independent", "ncv_cl2", "rel_error"), 2)` (NCV) over the cells. Under dependent errors REML's
error is `r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "reml_cl2", "rel_error"), 2)` (maximum
`r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "reml_cl2", "rel_error_max"), 1)`), above 0.5 in
`r rs("beta", "dependent", "reml_cl2", "cells_rel_gt_0.5")` of
`r rs("beta", "dependent", "reml_cl2", "cells")` cells, NCV's
`r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "ncv_cl2", "rel_error"), 2)` (@fig-relerr, @tbl-relerr). In the core cells the
REML/NCV ratio of the relative error is `r rng(rr("iid"), 1)` under independent and
`r rng(rr("dep"), 1)` under dependent errors (@tbl-relerr-core); the gap is present at every signal level
and largest at low signal. The spread of the selected smoothing parameters does not explain it: the SD
of log λ̂ of the ff penalties over replicates is `r rng(ls("REML", "iid"), 1)` (independent) and
`r rng(ls("REML", "dep"), 1)` (dependent) for REML, `r rng(ls("NCV", "iid"), 1)` and `r rng(ls("NCV", "dep"), 1)`
for NCV (largest for binary responses at G = 40; @tbl-logsp), and log-scale spreads at different levels of
smoothing are not comparable. What matters is where λ̂ lands: within a cell, REML's bad replicates are those
with a small λ̂ (λ-correction run on the 18 core cells at the default signal, `lambda-correction/flag-check.R`:
Spearman correlation between small log λ̂ of one of the two ff penalties and the relative error 0.94–0.95 under
dependence, mean over cells). The other estimands are estimated well by both fits
(@tbl-relerr).

The intervals mirror this. Under dependence REML + CL2 covers β (median
`r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "reml_cl2", "coverage"), 3)`) with a half-width of
`r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "reml_cl2", "halfwidth"), 2)` times the size of the effect and detects
`r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "reml_cl2", "detect"), 2)` of the clearly non-zero grid points; NCV + CL2
(coverage `r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "ncv_cl2", "coverage"), 3)`) has half-width
`r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "ncv_cl2", "halfwidth"), 2)` and detects
`r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "ncv_cl2", "detect"), 2)`; the bias-aware interval inherits REML's noise through
δ (half-width `r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "ncv_cl2_bias", "halfwidth"), 2)`, detection
`r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "ncv_cl2_bias", "detect"), 2)`). Wrong-sign exclusions stay rare for the CL2
intervals (at most `r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "reml_cl2", "wrong_sign_max"), 3)` of the grid for REML +
CL2, `r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "ncv_cl2", "wrong_sign_max"), 3)` for NCV + CL2) but reach
`r f(rs("beta", "dependent", "reml_model", "wrong_sign_max"), 2)` for model-based REML intervals.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-relerr
#| tbl-cap: "Relative error and interval informativeness per estimand, dependence and interval: cells, median coverage, median and maximum relative error of the estimate, cells with relative error > 0.5, mean share of replicates with relative error > 1, median relative half-width, median and minimum detection rate, maximum wrong-sign rate (all synthetic cells)."
show(rel_sum |> rename(dep. = dependence, cov. = coverage, rel = rel_error, `rel max` = rel_error_max, `cells >0.5` = cells_rel_gt_0.5, `reps >1` = reps_rel_gt_1, hw = halfwidth, det = detect, `det min` = detect_min, `wrong max` = wrong_sign_max) |> mutate(dep. = substr(dep., 1, 3)), digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-relerr-core
#| tbl-cap: "Relative error of the β estimate (median over replicates), REML and NCV, and their ratio, core cells."
show(rel_core, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-logsp
#| tbl-cap: "SD over replicates of the selected log smoothing parameters of the ff term (mean over its two penalties), core cells at the default signal."
show(lsp_core, digits = 2)
```
